name: Oamishirasato (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Oamishirasato city emblem in white: a ring open at the top with two small discs, enclosing a stylised device at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Oamishirasato, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1955.

features.role: Oamishirasato city emblem — a ring open at the top with two small discs, enclosing a stylised device at the bottom
